   "id": "7a5a78d2",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# Marching Tetrahedra\n",
    "\n",
    "Marching tetrahedra splits every cell into six tetrahedra and extracts\n",
    "the surface per tetrahedron. A tetrahedron has no ambiguous sign\n",
    "configurations, so the mesh is watertight and consistent by\n",
    "construction. The price is roughly 2-3x more triangles than marching\n",
    "cubes, with worse triangle shapes and a slight directional grain from\n",
    "the cell split. The method goes back to {cite:t}`doi1991`.\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "id": "bd2f95e8",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-07-07T05:57:35.786113Z",

     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-07-07T05:57:36.552278Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-07-07T05:57:36.551645Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "import torch\n",
    "import isoext\n",
    "from isoext import viewer\n",
    "from isoext.sdf import SphereSDF"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "c3f3aedf",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Basic Usage\n",
    "\n",
    "The interface matches the other extraction methods: a grid with scalar\n",
    "values in, vertex and face tensors out.\n"
   ]
  },

    "grid = isoext.UniformGrid([32, 32, 32])\n",
    "grid.set_values(SphereSDF(radius=0.7)(grid.get_points()))\n",
    "\n",
    "vertices, faces = isoext.marching_tetrahedra(grid)\n",
    "print(f\"marching_tetrahedra: {faces.shape[0]:,} triangles\")\n",
    "\n",
    "v_mc, f_mc = isoext.marching_cubes(grid)\n",
    "print(f\"marching_cubes:      {f_mc.shape[0]:,} triangles\")\n",
    "\n",
    "viewer.embed(vertices, faces, color=\"tomato\", flat_shading=True)"
   ]
  },

   "source": [
    "## How It Works\n",
    "\n",
    "Each cube is split into six tetrahedra that all share the cube's\n",
    "main diagonal. The purple lines below are the extra edges the split\n",
    "introduces: one diagonal per face, plus the main diagonal itself:\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "id": "ad865625",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-07-07T05:57:36.826377Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-07-07T05:57:36.826231Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-07-07T05:57:36.841841Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-07-07T05:57:36.841073Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/html": [
       "\n",
       "        <iframe\n",
       "            width=\"100%\"\n",
       "            height=\"300\"\n",
       "            src=\"_static/viser/index.html?playbackPath=../scenes/3f547271512f9bf4.viser&initialCameraPosition=1.976,1.976,1.383&initialCameraLookAt=0.000,0.000,0.000&initialCameraUp=0,0,1\"\n",
       "            frameborder=\"0\"\n",
       "            allowfullscreen\n",
       "            style=\"border: 1px solid #8888; border-radius: 4px;\"\n",
       "        ></iframe>\n",
       "        "
      ],
      "text/plain": [
       "<IPython.lib.display.IFrame at 0x799332751130>"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 3,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "cell = isoext.UniformGrid([2, 2, 2])\n",
    "cell.set_values(torch.tensor(\n",
    "    [-0.5, 0.3, 0.4, 0.5, 0.6, 0.4, 0.3, 0.2], device=\"cuda\"\n",
    ").reshape(2, 2, 2))\n",
    "\n",
    "corners = cell.get_points().reshape(8, 3)\n",
    "tets = [[0, 4, 6, 7], [0, 5, 4, 7], [0, 6, 2, 7],\n",
    "        [0, 2, 3, 7], [0, 1, 5, 7], [0, 3, 1, 7]]  # the split used by src/mt.cu\n",
    "edges = {tuple(sorted((t[i], t[j]))) for t in tets for i in range(4) for j in range(i + 1, 4)}\n",
    "diagonals = torch.stack([torch.stack([corners[a], corners[b]])\n",
    "                         for a, b in edges if bin(a ^ b).count(\"1\") > 1])\n",
    "viewer.embed(grid=cell, height=300,\n",
    "             draw=lambda s: viewer.add_lines(s, diagonals, color=\"orchid\"))\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "e8abcc7b",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "A tetrahedron has 4 corners and only 16 sign patterns, each\n",
    "producing one or two triangles with no choices to make, so the mesh\n",
    "is consistent by construction. The price shows on a field with one\n",
    "corner inside: the surface also crosses the diagonals, and marching\n",
    "cubes' single triangle becomes six:\n"
   ]
  },

   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "861c686f",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## When to Use It\n",
    "\n",
    "Pick marching tetrahedra when guaranteed topology matters more than\n",
    "triangle count, for example as input to solvers or simplification\n",
    "passes that assume a closed manifold. For visual quality at the same\n",
    "budget, marching cubes gives cleaner triangles.\n"
   ]
  },
